summary: Operator-approved contract correction extends to the completion step of a break-fix or implementation workflow: a nonterminal item, one or more active contracts, no unsettled attempt, and a same-work observation recorded after the latest verdict admit the typed supersession, whose successor carries the reserved complete_step_correction convention, returns the instance to repair or execution under the generated definition, and cuts predecessor verdicts and evidence off the successor and its descendants.
title: Contract correction at the completion step
